title: Tara's lament for death of Vali
introduction: Tara's lamentation is narrated in here. Seeing at her departed husband Vali, Tara pitiably wails for his demise as any ordinary woman would.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये किष्किन्ध काण्डे त्रयो विंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 23rd chapter in Kishkindha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततः समुपजिघ्रंती कपि राजस्य तत् मुखम् |
पतिम् लोकश्रुता तारा मृतम् वचनम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ samupajighraṃtī kapi rājasya tat mukham |
patim lokaśrutā tārā mṛtam vacanam abravīt
verses.translation: Then that renowned Tara closely whiffed that face of monkey's king Vali and spoke these words to her dead husband.

glosses.meaning: fell out from this world - Vali]

verses.devanagari:
शेषे त्वम् विषमे दुःखम् अकृत्वा वचनम् मम |
उपल उपचिते वीर सुदुःखे वसुधा तले
verses.iast:
śeṣe tvam viṣame duḥkham akṛtvā vacanam mama |
upala upacite vīra suduḥkhe vasudhā tale
verses.translation: "Heedless of my word, oh, brave one, you are reposing miserably on a very rough and uneven ground spread with stones.

glosses.meaning: my, word, not, doing - heedless of my word

verses.devanagari:
मत्तः प्रियतरा नूनम् वानरेन्द्र मही तव |
शेषे हि ताम् परिष्वज्य माम् च न प्रतिभाषसे
verses.iast:
mattaḥ priyatarā nūnam vānarendra mahī tava |
śeṣe hi tām pariṣvajya mām ca na pratibhāṣase
verses.translation: "This earth must definitely be your beloved one, oh, best of monkeys, why because, you still embrace her while you recline on her, without replying me.

glosses.meaning: her - earth, on embracing, you repose
to me, not, in turn, speaking -replying.

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवस्य वशम् प्राप्तो विधिः एष भवत्य अहो |
सुग्रीव एव विक्रांतो वीर साहसिक प्रिय
verses.iast:
sugrīvasya vaśam prāpto vidhiḥ eṣa bhavatya aho |
sugrīva eva vikrāṃto vīra sāhasika priya
verses.translation: "You have gone into the control of Sugreeva and Sugreeva alone triumphed, oh, brave one, oh, enthusiast in adventures, oho, is it fated to happen this way.

glosses.meaning: oh, in adventures, enthusiast sugriivasya vasham praaptaH = Sugreeva's, control, you obtained - you have gone in
this way, fate, is happening [in an interrogative]

verses.label: 4.23.5, 6a
verses.devanagari:
ऋक्ष वानर मुख्याः त्वाम् बलिनम् पर्युपासते |
तेषाम् विलपितम् कृच्छ्रम् अंगदस्य च शोचतः
मम च इमा गिरः श्रुत्वा किम् त्वम् न प्रतिबुध्यसे |
verses.iast:
ṛkṣa vānara mukhyāḥ tvām balinam paryupāsate |
teṣām vilapitam kṛcchram aṃgadasya ca śocataḥ
mama ca imā giraḥ śrutvā kim tvam na pratibudhyase |
verses.translation: "These chiefs of bears and monkeys are adoring you in every respect as their most worshipful one, and on hearing their despairing wailing, and the lamentation of Angada, and even these utterance of mine in keen, why do not you comeback to senses.

glosses.meaning: [you as the] mightiest one, you, wholly, are adoring
in turn, wake up, come to senses.

verses.label: 4.23.6b, 7a
verses.devanagari:
इदम् तत् वीर शयनम् तत्र शेषे हतो युधि
शायिता निहता यत्र त्वया एव रिपवः पुरा |
verses.iast:
idam tat vīra śayanam tatra śeṣe hato yudhi
śāyitā nihatā yatra tvayā eva ripavaḥ purā |
verses.translation: "Do you wish to repose on the very daybed on which you have laid your enemies to rest when you have once felled them in fights, or what?

glosses.meaning: there [on the very daybed,] do you wish to recline

verses.label: 4.23.7b, 8a
verses.devanagari:
विशुद्ध सत्त्व अभिजन प्रिययुद्ध मम प्रिय
माम् अनाथाम् विहाय एकाम् गतः त्वम् असि मानद |
verses.iast:
viśuddha sattva abhijana priyayuddha mama priya
mām anāthām vihāya ekām gataḥ tvam asi mānada |
verses.translation: "Oh, successor of a clan with pristine calibre, oh, accorder of dignity, oh, devotee of fighting, oh, my dear, have you gone on leaving me without a protector and lonely?

glosses.meaning: oh, one fond of - a devotee of, fighting
oh, my, dear one - devout one to me

verses.label: 4.23.8b, 9a
verses.devanagari:
शूराय न प्रदातव्या कन्या खलु विपश्चिता
शूर भार्याम् हताम् पश्य सद्यो माम् विधवाम् कृताम् |
verses.iast:
śūrāya na pradātavyā kanyā khalu vipaścitā
śūra bhāryām hatām paśya sadyo mām vidhavām kṛtām |
verses.translation: "Really considerate fathers shall never propose brides to adventurers, they say. Yes! See me the wife of an adventurer, in a trice rendered as a war-widow left in the lurch.
notes: For this Sage Kaatyaana says : dūrasthānām avidyānām mokṣa mārga anusāriṇām | śūrāṇām nir dhanānām ca na deyā kanyakā budhaiḥ ||'to those bridegrooms who reside in distant places, uneducated, seekers of salvation, daring ones, un-wealthy brides shall not be given by wisemen...'

glosses.meaning: by really, considerate ones [father of brides]
to adventurers, not, to be proposed, they say

verses.label: 4.23.9b, 10a
verses.devanagari:
अवभग्नः च मे मानो भग्ना मे शाश्वती गतिः
अगाधे च निमग्ना अस्मि विपुले शोक सागरे |
verses.iast:
avabhagnaḥ ca me māno bhagnā me śāśvatī gatiḥ
agādhe ca nimagnā asmi vipule śoka sāgare |
verses.translation: "My honour is degenerated and my eternal happiness is disintegrated, and I am deluged in an abyssal boundless ocean called anguish.

glosses.meaning: my, self-respect, honour as an empress

verses.label: 4.23.10b, 11a
verses.devanagari:
अश्म सारमयम् नूनम् इदम् मे हृदयम् दृढम्
भर्तारम् निहतम् दृष्ट्वा यत् न अद्य शतधा गतम् |
verses.iast:
aśma sāramayam nūnam idam me hṛdayam dṛḍham
bhartāram nihatam dṛṣṭvā yat na adya śatadhā gatam |
verses.translation: "And dense with metallic substance is this heart of mine in its solidity, since it is not splintering into hundredfold even on seeing my husband killed, it is definite.

glosses.meaning: now, in hundredfold, not, gone into [splintered]

verses.label: 4.23.11b, 12a
verses.devanagari:
सुहृत् चैव हि भर्ता च प्रकृत्या च मम प्रियः
प्रहारे च पराक्रान्तः शूरः पंचत्वम् आगतः |
verses.iast:
suhṛt caiva hi bhartā ca prakṛtyā ca mama priyaḥ
prahāre ca parākrāntaḥ śūraḥ paṃcatvam āgataḥ |
verses.translation: "By your nature you are my beloved, besides, you are a good-hearted one, more so, you are my husband, moreover, you are a valiant triumphing over your enemies in assaults, such as you are you have attained the fifth state, the death.

glosses.meaning: to me prakR^ityaa priyaH = by nature, beloved one
in assaults, others - enemies, overcoming [triumphant one]

verses.label: 4.23.12b, 13a
verses.devanagari:
पति हीना तु या नारी कामम् भवतु पुत्रिणी
धन धान्य समृद्धा अपि विधवा इति उच्यते जनैः |
verses.iast:
pati hīnā tu yā nārī kāmam bhavatu putriṇī
dhana dhānya samṛddhā api vidhavā iti ucyate janaiḥ |
verses.translation: "Perhaps a woman might have mothered many children, and perhaps affluent with riches and crops, still people will call her a widow, if she is without husband.

glosses.meaning: mothered [many children,] she may be, perhaps
riches, food grains [yields,] well, prosperous with, even if

verses.label: 4.23.13b, 14a
verses.devanagari:
स्व गात्र प्रभवे वीर शेषे रुधिर मण्डले
कृमि राग परिस्तोमे स्वकीये शयने यथा |
verses.iast:
sva gātra prabhave vīra śeṣe rudhira maṇḍale
kṛmi rāga paristome svakīye śayane yathā |
verses.translation: "How do you repose now on a sheet of blood flowing from your own body, oh, brave one, as if you are reclining on your own bed spread with a bed sheet of red blood colour?

glosses.meaning: insect, red [the red coloured insects, namely Indragopa insect, a bed sheet in that colour]
spread-sheet, bed sheet spread over a bed
on your own, bed, as if

verses.label: 4.23.14b, 15a
verses.devanagari:
रेणु शोणित संवीतम् गात्रम् तव समंततः
परिरब्धुम् न शक्नोमि भुजाभ्याम् प्लवगर्षभ |
verses.iast:
reṇu śoṇita saṃvītam gātram tava samaṃtataḥ
parirabdhum na śaknomi bhujābhyām plavagarṣabha |
verses.translation: "I have no strength to closely embrace you with both my arms, oh, best fly-jumper, when the blood and dust covering your body comes in between.

glosses.meaning: not, able to I have no strength.

verses.label: 4.23.15b, 16a
verses.devanagari:
कृत कृत्यो अद्य सुग्रीवो वैरे अस्मिन् अतिदारुणे
यस्य राम विमुक्तेन हृतम् एक इषुणा भयम् |
verses.iast:
kṛta kṛtyo adya sugrīvo vaire asmin atidāruṇe
yasya rāma vimuk{}tena hṛtam eka iṣuṇā bhayam |
verses.translation: "Single arrow released by Rama has doubly benefited Sugreeva in this highly deplorable enmity between you and Sugreeva, as his ambition to become the king is fulfilled and his fear from your persecution, too, is evanished.

glosses.meaning: highly, deplorable, in this, enmity [between you and Sugreeva]
now, Sugreeva, is ambition is fulfilled - accomplished one

verses.label: 4.23.16b, 17a
verses.devanagari:
शरेण हृदि लग्नेन गात्र संस्पर्शने तव
वार्यामि त्वाम् निरीक्षन्ती त्वयि पंचत्वम् आगते |
verses.iast:
śareṇa hṛdi lagnena gātra saṃspar.hśane tava
vār.hyāmi tvām nirīkṣantī tvayi paṃcatvam āgate |
verses.translation: "In vain, I have been watching you without a wink, on whom fatality has descended, as this arrow stuck in your chest is hindering me to embrace you..." Thus wailed Tara.

glosses.meaning: for you, fifth state - death, when it came on - fatality has descended
in your, chest, stuck, by arrow

verses.label: 4.23.17b, 18a
verses.devanagari:
उद्बबर्ह शरम् नीलः तस्य गात्र गतम् तदा
गिरि गह्वर संलीनम् दीप्तम् आशी विषम् यथा |
verses.iast:
udbabarha śaram nīlaḥ tasya gātra gatam tadā
giri gahvara saṃlīnam dīptam āśī viṣam yathā |
verses.translation: "Then the monkey chief Nila extricated that arrow which is stuck in the chest of Vali, as with the extraction of a firmly wedged sparkling snake from the cavity of a mound.

glosses.meaning: his [Valis's,] body - chest, gone in [stuck in,] arrow

verses.label: 4.23.18b, 19a
verses.devanagari:
तस्य निष्कृष्यमाणस्य बाणस्य च बभौ द्युतिः
अस्त मस्तक संरुद्धो रश्मिः दिनकरात् इव |
verses.iast:
tasya niṣ.hkṛṣyamāṇasya bāṇasya ca babhau dyutiḥ
asta mastaka saṃruddho raśmiḥ dinakarāt iva |
verses.translation: The sparkle of Rama's arrow while it is being extracted from Vali's chest is much the same as the sparkles of more brilliant sunrays that are extracted by the end of daytime, when the sun is sinking beyond the summit of dusky western mountain, and as contrasted with the hue of dusk.
notes: More brilliant days are indicated for the arrows of Rama as the dusky day of Vali has ended.

glosses.meaning: from sun - that which is extricated from sun
fully, obstructed - as contrasted with [the hue of dusk]

verses.label: 4.23.19b, 20a
verses.devanagari:
पेतुः क्षतज धाराः तु व्रणेभ्यः तस्य सर्वशः
ताम्र गैरिक संपृक्ता धारा इव धरा धरात् |
verses.iast:
petuḥ kṣataja dhārāḥ tu vraṇebhyaḥ tasya sarvaśaḥ
tāmra gairika sampṛk{}tā dhārā iva dharā dharāt |
verses.translation: The blood streams flown out of the gashes of Vali fell everywhere like the streams of water flowing from a mountain saturated with coppery mineral-ores.

glosses.meaning: from the one borne, by earth - from mountain

verses.label: 4.23.20b, 21a
verses.devanagari:
अवकीर्णम् विमार्जन्ती भर्तारम् रण रेणुना
अस्रैः नयनजैः शूरम् सिषेच अस्त्र समाहतम् |
verses.iast:
avakīrṇam vimārjantī bhartāram raṇa reṇunā
asraiḥ nayanajaiḥ śūram siṣeca astra samāhatam |
verses.translation: On wiping off war dust with which her husband is muffled up, with tears gushing from her eyes she drenched that valiant one who is summarily hit by the missile of Rama.

glosses.meaning: eyes, born to, tears - eyes gushing tears

verses.label: 4.23.21b, 22a
verses.devanagari:
रुधिरोक्षित सर्वान्गम् दृष्ट्वा विनिहतम् पतिम्
उवाच तारा पिंगाक्षम् पुत्रम् अंगदम् अंगना |
verses.iast:
rudhirokṣita sarvāngam dṛṣṭvā vinihatam patim
uvāca tārā piṃgākṣam putram aṃgadam aṃganā |
verses.translation: On giving attention to all of the blood wet limbs of her slain husband that lady Tara spoke to her son Angada whose eyes are coppery-red.

glosses.meaning: to son, to coppery red, eyed one

verses.label: 4.23.22b, 23a
verses.devanagari:
अवस्थाम् पश्चिमाम् पश्य पितुः पुत्र सुदारुणाम्
संप्रसक्तस्य वैरस्य गतो अन्तः पाप कर्मणा |
verses.iast:
avasthām paścimām paśya pituḥ putra sudāruṇām
samprasak{}tasya vairasya gato antaḥ pāpa karmaṇā |
verses.translation: "See the highly harrowing end time plight of your father, oh, son, he reached his end owing to the enmity harnessed by sinful deeds.

glosses.meaning: of father, oh, son, highly, harrowing

verses.label: 4.23.23b, 24a
verses.devanagari:
बाल सूर्योज्ज्वल तनुम् प्रयातम् यम सादनम्
अभिवादय राजानम् पितरम् पुत्र मानदम् |
verses.iast:
bāla sūryojjvala tanum prayātam yama sādanam
abhivādaya rājānam pitaram putra mānadam |
verses.translation: "To him, whose physical splendour vied with the dazzle of rising sun, to that father, king, and the accorder of honour you pay you last obeisance as he journeyed to the abode of Time-god." Thus Tara said to Angada.

glosses.meaning: young [rising,] son, [as with in] dazzle, bodied - whose physical splendour is

verses.label: 4.23.24b, 25a
verses.devanagari:
एवम् उक्तः समुत्थाय जग्राह चरणौ पितुः
भुजाभ्याम् पीन वृताभ्याम् अंगदो अहम् इति ब्रुवन् |
verses.iast:
evam uk{}taḥ samutthāya jagrāha caraṇau pituḥ
bhujābhyām pīna vṛtābhyām aṃgado aham iti bruvan |
verses.translation: When he is said so, Angada swiftly rose and touched the feet of his father with both of his rotund-shouldered sinewy arms saying, "father, I am Angada..."

glosses.meaning: thus, who is said to, Angada

verses.label: 4.23.25b, 26a
verses.devanagari:
अभिवादयमानम् त्वाम् अंगदम् त्वम् यथा पुरा
दीर्घ आयुर् भव पुत्र इति किम् अर्थम् न अभिभाषसे |
verses.iast:
abhivādayamānam tvām aṃgadam tvam yathā purā
dīrgha āyur bhava putra iti kim artham na abhibhāṣase |
verses.translation: "Why do not you bless Angada saying, 'long live, son...' when he is paying resects to you, as earlier?" Thus Tara is addressing Vali in her anguish.

glosses.meaning: to him who is paying respects

verses.label: 4.23.26b
verses.devanagari:
अहम् पुत्र सहाया त्वाम् उपासे गत चेतनम् |
सिंहेन पातितम् सद्यो गौः स वत्सा इव गो वृषम्
verses.iast:
aham putra sahāyā tvām upāse gata cetanam |
siṃhena pātitam sadyo gauḥ sa vatsā iva go vṛṣam
verses.translation: "I am living through seeing the lifeless state of yours with the help of my son, no more than a helpless cow that sits near her bull with its calf, when that bull is slain by a lion, just now. [3-23-26b, c]

glosses.meaning: with, calf, [a helpless] cow, as like

verses.devanagari:
इष्ट्वा संग्राम यज्ञेन राम प्रहरण अंभसा |
अस्मिन् अवभृथे स्नातः कथम् पत्न्या मया विना
verses.iast:
iṣṭvā saṅgrāma yajñena rāma praharaṇa ambhasā |
asmin avabhṛthe snātaḥ katham patnyā mayā vinā
verses.translation: "How can you singly take the ultimate bath of a Vedic ritual after your conducting a ritual like combat, in the waters called bloodstreams caused by Rama's arrow, that too, when I, your wife, am available like a co-officiator of a Vedic ritual?
notes: This avabṛtha is a religious bath taken after completion of the Vedic ritual by the conductor of that ritual along with his wife. Vedic ritual itself is forbidden to a wifeless person, and taking this final bath after pūrṇa āhuti, total oblation, is against the rules of ritual if taken without his wife. Here Vali, an adorer of combats as good as Vedic rituals is taking that bath for himself in the bloodstreams, called ritual waters, and Tara is questioning him about her propriety to participate in it.

verses.devanagari:
या दत्ता देव राजेन तव तुष्टेन संयुगे |
शात कौम्भीम् प्रियाम् मालाम् ताम् ते पश्यामि न इह किम्
verses.iast:
yā dattā deva rājena tava tuṣṭena saṃyuge |
śāta kaum.hbhīm priyām mālām tām te paśyāmi na iha kim
verses.translation: "Now where is that treasured golden pendant of yours which the king of gods gave to you when he is satisfied with your conduct in wars, I don't see it?

glosses.meaning: in combat [about your conduct in combats]
by the satisfied, gods, king - Indra

verses.devanagari:
राज्यश्रीः न जहाति त्वाम् गत असुम् अपि मानद |
सूर्यस्य आवर्तमानस्य शैल राजम् इव प्रभा
verses.iast:
rājyaśrīḥ na jahāti tvām gata asum api mānada |
sūryasya āvartamānasya śaila rājam iva prabhā
verses.translation: "Majesty is not deserting you even if your lives have departed, oh, accorder of dignity, as with the sunshine that departs the sun while he circumnavigates Mt. Meru, which mount is supposed to overshadow everything by its vastness.

glosses.meaning: one with gone, lives, even if

verses.devanagari:
न मे वचः पथ्यम् इदम् त्वया कृतम्
न च अस्मि शक्ता हि निवारणे तव |
हता सपुत्रा अस्मि हतेन संयुगे
सह त्वया श्रीः विजहाति माम् अपि
verses.iast:
na me vacaḥ pathyam idam tvayā kṛtam
na ca asmi śak{}tā hi nivāraṇe tava |
hatā saputrā asmi hatena saṃyuge
saha tvayā śrīḥ vijahāti mām api
verses.translation: "Neither you heeded my word of expediency, nor I was indeed capable to forestall you, and I am doomed along with my son when you are exterminated in fight, whereby the Grace that forsook you, is deserting me too, in its entirety.

glosses.meaning: capable, not, I am, also, indeed
in fight, by you who is killed
